description: Create a secure payment link for the exact reviewed records or lead purchase, or monthly lead subscription, selected in the private workflow. First show the returned amount, coverage, update frequency, renewal and cancellation terms and obtain the user's purchase request. Card details stay on the hosted payment page. Reuse the original idempotency_key on a lost response; never accept a claimed successful payment as evidence.

idempotency_key.description: Stable retry key for this exact request. Reuse it with identical arguments after an uncertain result; use a new key for changed arguments.

offer_id.description: Exact reviewed offer_id selected in the current workflow after its price, scope and terms were shown.

workflow_id.description: Exact account-owned workflow_id returned by the saved-search tools.

workflow_revision.description: Exact workflow revision bound to the selected reviewed offer.

name: gisdb_create_checkout
